subject: Production latency spike & throughput drop — RCA and corrective sprint
messages:
From: Alexandra Pierce <a.pierce@clearbridge.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Naidu <samir.naidu@clearbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Production issues this morning — immediate exec engagement required

Jasmine,

We had a serious impact during this morning's PST peak (08:00–09:15). Starting ~08:05 we saw sustained 5xx error rates across our inference routes, latency increased from ~120ms p50 to >2s p50, and throughput for our storefront model dropped by ~45% for ~70 minutes. This caused cascading UI timeouts and a visible revenue impact for two of our key retail regions.

We escalated on-call but need executive visibility and a formal RCA. Can you confirm who at Redwood will own the post-incident RCA and a concrete corrective plan (timing, owners, and potential credits)? We also need temporary mitigation to restore the throughput profile for morning traffic.

Samir and I are available for a readout today.

Thanks,
Alexandra Pierce
Director, Platform Engineering
ClearBridge Retail

Attachments: sample_error_window.log (stub), screenshots.png (stub)

Subject: Re: Production issues this morning — immediate exec engagement required

Team — putting this on our emergency queue. Alex reports: 08:05–09:15 PST spike, high 5xx, latency >2s, throughput drop ~45%. Customer-facing impact, exec attention requested.

Immediate asks:
- Ben: can you run preliminary diagnostics (KV cache health, autoscaler events, model host OOMs) and confirm if any kernel/driver updates were applied overnight?
- Karthik: check routing/fallback rules and whether a fallback to the lower-cost model variant triggered unexpectedly.
- Marcus/Grace: prepare an exec readout slide (1 slide) and draft a customer note with clear next steps.

I'll set up a 30-minute bridge and propose the following timeline: preliminary findings in 90 minutes, customer-facing RCA draft within 6 hours, and a follow-up with execs within 24 hours. If you can't hit those windows call me directly.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production issues this morning — immediate exec engagement required

Quick diagnostics summary (prelim):
- Observed repeated rebalances across the GPU pool servicing ClearBridge's tenant between 07:58 and 08:12 PST; autoscaler invoked three scale-up/scale-down cycles due to mis-sized readiness probes (SUP-12958).
- Several model hosts reported transient OOMs at 08:04–08:08; kernel messaging shows high GC pressure from a new caching heuristic rolled out in the runtime on 2027-08-18.
- Routing policy: a fallback rule to a quantized model variant triggered when hosts reported >30% CPU contention; that variant has ~30% lower throughput for the customer workload.

Immediate mitigations applied at 08:20 (during incident):
- Temporarily pinned ClearBridge traffic to the stable instance pool (bypass autoscaler) — restored ~60% of throughput by 08:35.
- Rolled back the caching heuristic on affected hosts (hotfix) — eliminated OOMs by 08:40.
- Throttled background maintenance jobs that were overlapping morning window.

I've created SUP-12958 and attached preliminary diagnostics (prelim_diagnostics.txt). Proposed next steps:
1) Canary a kernel-safe patch to the runtime that adjusts cache GC thresholds (owner: Ben) — canary window 48h.
2) Adjust autoscaler readiness probe logic to avoid oscillation (owner: Karthik) — deployment within 72h.
3) Permanently change fallback routing thresholds for critical tenants to prefer latency-preserving fallbacks (owner: Marcus) — target 5 business days.

I'll keep the logs and metrics in the SUP ticket.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: prelim_diagnostics.txt
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alexandra Pierce <a.pierce@clearbridge.com>, Samir Naidu <samir.naidu@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: ClearBridge: RCA & corrective sprint plan (summary and commitments)

Alexandra / Samir — thank you again for the quick escalation call. Below is our consolidated RCA and the corrective sprint commitments. We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your partnership while we remediate and harden against recurrence.

Executive summary (what happened):
- Primary driver: runtime caching heuristic introduced 2027-08-18 increased GC pressure, causing transient OOMs on several model hosts during the PST morning concurrency spike.
- Secondary driver: autoscaler readiness probe configuration caused repeated scale oscillation; fallback to a quantized model variant reduced throughput and increased end-to-end latency.

What we did during the incident:
- Hotfix rollback of the caching heuristic (08:20–08:40) — restored host stability.
- Temporarily pinned ClearBridge traffic to the stable pool to regain throughput (08:20–08:35).
- Throttled maintenance jobs overlapping the peak window.

Corrective sprint (owners & timing):
- Ben (Runtime): Canary runtime patch adjusting GC thresholds and cache safety checks — canary begins 48 hours from now; goal to complete validation in 5 days.
- Karthik (Autoscaler): Update readiness probes and autoscaler smoothing logic — deploy within 72 hours.
- Marcus (Routing): Update fallback routing thresholds for production-critical tenants and add explicit per-tenant override — staged rollout in 5 business days.
- Jasmine (CS): Weekly status until closure; exec readout scheduled one week from today.

Compensation and near-term protections:
- Redwood will issue a one-time service credit equivalent to 8 hours of provisioned capacity to ClearBridge (to be reflected on next invoice).
- We will temporarily extend log retention for ClearBridge to 30 days to support post-mortem verification.

Attached: RCA_v1.pdf (full timeline & logs), mitigation_plan.xlsx (detailed actions and owners).
Relevant links: https://redwood-drive.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-clearbridge-rca, JIRA SUP-12958.

Would you like an executive readout (30 min) with our CTO and Head of Reliability this week? We can schedule for a time that aligns with your morning window.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RCA_v1.pdf, mitigation_plan.xlsx

Alexandra
